questions.stem: What is the primary cause of water erosion?
questions.explanation: Water erosion is primarily caused by rainfall and surface runoff, which can wash away the topsoil. Other options, while related to soil issues, do not directly cause water erosion.

distractorRationale.b: Poor farming practices can contribute to erosion but are not the primary cause of water erosion.
distractorRationale.c: Soil compaction affects water infiltration but does not directly cause water erosion.
